title: The Search for Statistical Indistinguishability Between Real and Fake Images
summary: Across MNIST, CelebA, FFHQ and GenImage, trained classifiers generally still separate real and generated images after tested abstractions; chance cases require severe information loss. Four named datasets and multiple generator/classifier settings are tested; failure to distinguish after severe abstraction is not evidence of distributional identity generally.
ai_technology: Deep neural classifiers are trained to distinguish real from generated images across datasets and progressively abstracted representations.
